desc: Ideation: reduce to binary search on X and minimum walk satisfying required visit counts r_i.
Implement binary-search + O(n) feasibility (edge-traversal/parity DP over end e).
Brute-force validate the solution on small n,m; confirm no off-by-one, parity, end-position, or MWIS-combination bugs.
Verify the two provided examples produce 4 and 2, and test edge cases (n=2, m=1, m<n → 0, very large m, large points values, X=0).
Performance test n=5e4, m=1e9, points=1e6 across binary search iterations to confirm it runs within time limits.
